response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff at 3.98 is exclusive (>) rather than inclusive (>=). The phrase 'higher-value invoices' suggests values strictly above the threshold.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, keeping invoices with Total >= 3.98
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98
